title: Email a receipt through Resend
summary: When an invoice is paid in full, email the customer a receipt from your own domain through Resend, once.
description: Whenever one of your invoices is paid in full and the customer gave an email address, Taskiem emails them a receipt from your own domain through Resend: the invoice number, the amount and a thank-you. Resend sends it once however often the step is retried. Your domain must be verified in Resend.

params.name: resend_connection
params.title: Resend connection
params.description: Your Resend account, by its API key.

params.name: from
params.title: From
params.description: The address receipts come from, on a domain verified in Resend: Ada Cakes <orders@adacakes.ng>.

input.subject: ='Receipt for invoice ' + trigger.body.number
input.text:
='Dear ' + trigger.body.customer.name + ',

Thank you: we have received ' + trigger.body.amount + ' for invoice ' + trigger.body.number + ', which is now paid in full.

' + steps.settings.output.business_name
